Subject: Security discovery: artifact request, PT handoff plan & disclosure cadence

Thanks again for taking time to speak with us today — appreciated the candid discussion on integration and operational needs. Quick recap + concrete asks so we can move the security intake forward: 

Recap (short):
- CareBridge will be a data processor for Redwood in the proposed flow; some customers will route PHI.
- You’re planning a procurement review in late Sep and need SOC/pen evidence for your legal/security team.
- Mutual interest in documenting vuln disclosure and remediation SLAs before pilot.

Action items / asks from Redwood:
1) SOC 2: Can you share your latest SOC 2 Type II (or SOC attestation letter) that covers production systems? If possible, a redacted PDF is fine.
2) PHI/HIPAA: Please confirm whether CareBridge will expect a BAA and point us to your legal contact.
3) Pen test: We need the most recent pen test executive summary and the contact for vulnerability disclosures. If the full report requires an NDA, we can execute — please tell us the process.
4) Vendor questionnaire: if you prefer, we can fill your questionnaire — attach here a short security packet (attached) and our vuln SLA template for discussion.
5) Scanning cadence / remediation expectations: any existing SLAs you operate to (e.g., critical within 30d) would help.

Attachments: redwood_security_packet_v1.pdf (summary: SOC scope, infra diagram, vuln SLA template)

Suggested next step: 30-min security sync to iron out sharing method and NDA. I’m available Wed 9/15 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 9/16 9:00–11:00 PT. If either works, I’ll send an invite with an agenda focused on: SOC evidence, pen test handoff, disclosure contacts, and timeboxes for remediation.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down so procurement can move.

—
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks, Avery — great call. Answers inline and attached items: 

1) SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II in July 2026; I’ve attached the attestation PDF (redacted for customer data).
2) PHI/HIPAA: Yes, CareBridge handles PHI in several workflows. We require a BAA for any customer-facing integration that touches PHI. Our legal contact is emma.lopez@carebridge.com.
3) Pen test: Third-party vendor performed a penetration test in June 2026. We can share the executive summary without an NDA; the full report requires a standard mutual NDA (we can redline if needed). Executive summary attached.
4) Vendor questionnaire: I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire. If you prefer joint review, we can fill the PDF and return it.
5) SLAs: Our security team typically acknowledges incoming reports within 48 hours; remediation windows vary by severity. We are open to the template you sent and can sync on specifics.

Attachments: carebridge_soc2_statement_2026.pdf; carebridge_pen_test_execsum_redacted.pdf; vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx

For the sync, Thu 9/16 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll ask our security lead (Emma) to join.

—

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Michael. A couple of engineering/security clarifications so we can scope the handoff correctly: 

- NDA: if CareBridge requires one to share the full report we’ll execute. Please send your standard mutual NDA or confirm we should share Redwood’s standard mutual NDA.
- Report & scope: ideally we get the executive summary now and the full report under NDA. Please include a list of in-scope asset identifiers (hostnames, service names, or IP ranges) and whether credentials were used for authenticated testing.
- Vulnerability disclosure & remediation SLAs (Redwood’s proposed baseline):
  • Initial acknowledgement: 72 hours
  • Critical (remote code execution / data exfil): remediation plan within 30 days; hotfix/patch in 30 days where feasible
  • High: remediation plan within 60 days, fix within 60–90 days
  • Medium/Low: remediation within 90 days or tracked for next sprint
  • Public disclosure: coordinated, no public disclosure until after remediation or explicit agreement

- Scanning cadence: we recommend authenticated SCA monthly, internal app scans monthly, external network scans quarterly. If CareBridge already runs a cadence, please share the schedule.
- Vulnerability intake: please confirm a primary contact and a PGP key or secure upload method for sensitive attachments. Our intake address is security-intake@redwood.com (monitored by the security ops team).

Attachment: redwood_vuln_sla_template.docx (template for redlining)

If Thu 9/16 10:00 PT is locked, I’ll join and we can finalize the NDA + plan.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
